consumedSourceInterfaces.name: BridgeTime
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue: abbrev BridgeTime := unitInterval

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: BridgeNoise
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue: abbrev BridgeNoise := {g : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) // g 0 = 0 ∧ g 1 = 0}

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: bridgePath
strictUpper
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def strictUpper (a y T z : ℝ) : Set BridgeNoise :=
  {g | ∀ t : BridgeTime, bridgePath y T z g t < a}

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: strictLower
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def strictLower (a y T z : ℝ) : Set BridgeNoise :=
  {g | ∀ t : BridgeTime, -a < bridgePath y T z g t}

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: strictInterval
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def strictInterval (a y T z : ℝ) : Set BridgeNoise :=
  strictUpper a y T z ∩ strictLower a y T z

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: upperCompletion
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def upperCompletion (P : Measure BridgeNoise) (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.real (strictUpper a y T z)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: lowerCompletion
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def lowerCompletion (P : Measure BridgeNoise) (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.real (strictLower a y T z)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: intervalCompletion
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def intervalCompletion (P : Measure BridgeNoise) (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.real (strictInterval a y T z)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: completion_bounds
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem completion_bounds (P : Measure BridgeNoise) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (a y T z : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ upperCompletion P a y T z ∧ upperCompletion P a y T z ≤ 1 ∧
    0 ≤ lowerCompletion P a y T z ∧ lowerCompletion P a y T z ≤ 1 ∧
    0 ≤ intervalCompletion P a y T z ∧ intervalCompletion P a y T z ≤ 1

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: leftWeight
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def leftWeight : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun t => 1 - (t : ℝ), by fun_prop⟩

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: rightWeight
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def rightWeight : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun t => (t : ℝ), by fun_prop⟩

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: pinPath
bridgeNoise
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def bridgeNoise {Ω : Type*} (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) : BridgeNoise :=
  pinPath (Shao.OQ4.PolygonalBrownianWeakLimit.brownianUnitPath B 1 ω)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: bridgeLaw
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
def bridgeLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) : Measure BridgeNoise :=
  P.map (bridgeNoise B)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: isProbabilityMeasure_bridgeLaw
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_bridgeLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) : IsProbabilityMeasure (bridgeLaw B P)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: interval_start_abs_increment
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem interval_start_abs_increment (ν : Measure BridgeNoise) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (a y y' T z : ℝ) :
    |intervalCompletion ν a y' T z - intervalCompletion ν a y T z| ≤
      |upperCompletion ν a y' T z - upperCompletion ν a y T z| +
        |lowerCompletion ν a y' T z - lowerCompletion ν a y T z|

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: bridge_upper_formula_pospart
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem bridge_upper_formula_pospart {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a y T z : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    upperCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) a y T z =
      1 - Real.exp (-2 * max (a - y) 0 * max (a - z) 0 / T)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: bridge_lower_formula_pospart
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem bridge_lower_formula_pospart {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a y T z : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    lowerCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) a y T z =
      1 - Real.exp (-2 * max (a + y) 0 * max (a + z) 0 / T)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: bridge_interval_continuous_endpoint
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem bridge_interval_continuous_endpoint {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a y T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    Continuous (fun w : ℝ => intervalCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) a y T w)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: integrable_killed_density
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem integrable_killed_density {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a y : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => gaussianPDFReal y T z *
      intervalCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) a y (T : ℝ) z)

consumedSourceInterfaces.name: brownian_physical_interval_joint_eq_integral
consumedSourceInterfaces.completeHeadOrValue:
theorem brownian_physical_interval_joint_eq_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a y : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : T ≠ 0)
    (A : Set ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    P.real {ω | (∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ T → |y + B s ω| < a) ∧ y + B T ω ∈ A} =
      ∫ z : ℝ in A, gaussianPDFReal y T z *
        intervalCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) a y (T : ℝ) z
